controles.affirmation: Proces federal actif (U.S. ex rel. Bayne) : le tribunal a rejete le 29 avril 2025 la motion to dismiss de DaVita ; la societe a repondu le 21 juillet 2025 et conteste les allegations.
controles.verbatim_source: On April 29, 2025, the Court denied the Company's motion to dismiss. On July 21, 2025, the Company answered the complaint. The Company disputes the allegations in the complaint and intends to defend this action accordingly. (10-Q Q2 2026, Note 7)

controles.affirmation: « le dossier reste ouvert malgre le refus des deux parquets federaux concernes d'intervenir directement dans la procedure »
controles.verbatim_source: On October 12, 2022, the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Eastern District of Pennsylvania notified the U.S. District Court, Eastern District of Pennsylvania, of its decision not to elect to intervene at this time in the matter of U.S. ex rel. Bayne v. DaVita Inc., et al. [...] In November 2022, the Company learned that, on April 1, 2022, the U.S. Attorney's Office for the District of New Jersey notified [...] its decision not to elect to intervene in the matter of U.S. ex rel. Doe v. DaVita Inc. and filed a Stipulation of Dismissal.
controles.correction_proposee: Un seul parquet federal (Eastern District of Pennsylvania) a decline d'intervenir dans Bayne, et seulement « at this time ». La non-intervention du parquet du New Jersey concerne une autre affaire (U.S. ex rel. Doe), classee sans prejudice en avril 2022. Ecrire : « le parquet federal de Pennsylvanie de l'Est a choisi de ne pas intervenir a ce stade ».

controles.affirmation: La FTC a adresse a DaVita en avril 2024 deux Civil Investigative Demands sur les clauses de non-concurrence avec les medecins, dans le cadre d'une enquete sectorielle en cours.
controles.verbatim_source: In April 2024, the Company received from the Federal Trade Commission (FTC) two CIDs in connection with an industry investigation under Section 5 of the Federal Trade Commission Act regarding the acquisition of medical director services and provision of dialysis services. The CIDs [...] generally seek information relating to restrictive covenants, such as non-competes, with physicians. The Company is cooperating with the government in this investigation.
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : le titre de section « enquete FTC en cours » pourrait laisser croire a une enquete visant DaVita ; le document precise « industry investigation ». Le corps du texte le dit deja correctement.

controles.affirmation: L'expiration fin 2025 des credits d'impot ACA renforces a un impact negatif sur les inscriptions et le mix commercial.
controles.verbatim_source: the decision to let enhanced premium tax credits expire at the end of 2025 has had an adverse impact on enrollment in the Affordable Care Act exchanges and our commercial mix, which in turn adversely impacts our revenue per treatment

controles.affirmation: « Seuls 26% des revenus de dialyse US proviennent de patients couverts par une assurance privee, en baisse d'un point sur un an » (repris en quantitatif : « 26% du chiffre d'affaires dialyse US »).
controles.verbatim_source: Three months ended June 30, 2026 - U.S. dialysis : Commercial (dialysis patient service) 940,228 + Commercial (other revenues) 6,241 ; Total U.S. dialysis 3,000,462. Total consolidated revenues 3,554,084.
controles.correction_proposee: Le commercial represente 31,5% du CA du segment dialyse US au T2 2026 (contre 33,0% un an plus tot, soit -1,5 pt). Le chiffre de 26% correspond au CA commercial dialyse US rapporte au CA CONSOLIDE (940,2/3 554,1 = 26,4%). Ecrire : « le commercial ne pese que 26% du chiffre d'affaires consolide », ou corriger a 31,5% si le denominateur reste la dialyse US. Aucune occurrence de « 26% » dans le 10-Q ni dans le communique de resultats.

controles.affirmation: La societe reconnait dans son 10-K que les payeurs commerciaux « generate nearly all of our profit ».
controles.verbatim_source: The payments we receive from commercial payors generate nearly all of our profit and all of our nonacute dialysis profits come from commercial payors. (10-K FY2025, Item 1A)
